context: A uni student helps a teen friend reframe a stage-fright moment
purpose: Teach: さておき/おもう/あがる/はずし/内心/さわやか/ネガティブ/交わし

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 発表のとき、頭真っ白で…内心パニックだったよ。
lines.en: During the speech my mind went blank... I was inwardly panicking.
lines.style: Teen confessing embarrassment, voice trailing off softly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかるよ。人前であがるの、誰でも経験あるって。
lines.en: I get it. Getting nervous in front of people, everyone has been there.
lines.style: Warm older-brother tone, reassuring and casual throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 途中でピントはずしたみたいに、楽譜のどこ弾いてるか分からなくなって、もう最悪。
lines.en: Like I lost focus midway, I had no idea where I was on the score, the worst.
lines.style: Frustrated teen venting, half-laughing at herself nervously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ネガティブに考えすぎだって。お客さんと視線を交わした瞬間あっただろ?
lines.en: You're thinking way too negatively. There was a moment you exchanged glances with the audience, right?
lines.style: Gentle pushback, friendly uni-student vibe with warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ…うん。前の席のおばさんが、にっこり微笑んでくれた。さわやかな気持ちになった。
lines.en: Ah... yeah. The lady in the front row smiled at me kindly. It made me feel refreshed.
lines.style: Quietly remembering, voice softening with gentle surprise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほら、それでいいんだよ。細かいミスはさておき、ちゃんと届いてた証拠だろ。
lines.en: See, that's what matters. Setting the small mistakes aside, that's proof it reached someone.
lines.style: Steady, encouraging, slight smile in his voice now.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そう言われると…そうおもうかも。次はもう少し堂々とやってみる。
lines.en: When you put it that way... maybe I do think so. Next time I'll try to stand prouder.
lines.style: Teen slowly brightening, regaining quiet confidence again.
